mount.note: FITTED to the head's own depth, not taped (scratch/arm_mount/), as variant B: the base square to the cart (Artem's photos of 2026-10-04: the base plate square to the basket's side wall, the folded arm forward along the right side, the gripper over the front rim) and shoulder_pan's zero corrected by joints.zero_offset_deg. The score alone prefers +19 (+19.7 run0/run1, +18.0 run3), pulled by the servo cable loops at the arm's front-left, which turn the model 15 deg counter-clockwise of the top and away from the photos (+17 deg off the wall at +19, +5 at +31). joints.note: pose_deg is the arm as it stands parked, READ 2026-10-04 13:15 through the base server's registers request (Present_Position of ids 1-6, torque off on all six; unchanged since 03:25 within 0.1 deg), after Artem re-posed it at 03:20 (turned counter-clockwise by a small angle, the wrist handled); the reading of 2026-10-02 23:20 (scratch/arm_mask/read_arm.py), which run0/run1 of the mount's depth fit used, was shoulder_pan -27.6, shoulder_lift -102.6, elbow_flex 96.8, wrist_flex 72.1, wrist_roll 10.2, gripper 4.6: the servos' EEPROM carries the lerobot calibration of 2026-08-30 to the tick (homing offsets and position limits = ~/.cache/huggingface/lerobot/calibration/robots/so_follower/pepin_follower.json), and the URDF's 'new calib' zero is the middle of each calibrated range, lerobot's DEGREES convention: angle = (ticks - (range_min + range_max) / 2) * 360 / 4096. The gripper is lerobot's linear 0-100 joint, here (ticks - range_min) * 360 / 4096 - 10 deg onto the URDF's -10..100. The signs are lerobot's = the URDF's. shoulder_pan's is verified by the re-pose: turned counter-clockwise, it read -6.7, and the URDF's pan axis is the base's -z (origin rpy pi 0 -pi), so a negative step turns it counter-clockwise. The others are NOT verified by a move: with them the parked arm stands folded on its base (scratch/arm_mask/folded_pose.py; shoulder_lift and elbow_flex sit at a stop each, the URDF's limits), with shoulder_lift or elbow_flex flipped it would reach 11 cm under its own base. shoulder_pan's zero is the least sure: its calibrated range is 174 deg against the URDF's 220, so its middle may sit up to ~23 deg off; with the base square (Artem's photos) the arm's top in the head's depth puts the URDF angle 31 deg above the reading (zero_offset_deg, mount note), more than that bound and less than the 40 deg between the pan's homing pose (2047 ticks) and its range middle (2503.5). zero_offset_deg (joint -> degrees) is added by pepin.arm to the angles of either source before the FK, so pose_deg and /arm/joint_states stay readings. source topic reads /arm/joint_states (sensor_msgs/JointState, these joint names, radians, URDF convention, stamped at the encoder read) and falls back to pose_deg when no sample lies within max_age_s of a frame.

links_source: scripts/arm_boxes.py: the tightest box along each link's own axes (or its vertices' principal axes, whichever is smaller; never smaller here), cut in two across the longest side where that saves a quarter of the volume, fitted to the visual meshes of TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 at 5f6d2b8 (Apache-2.0), exact hulls; margin_m grows every box at run time. scripts/arm_boxes.py --check compares this block with the meshes.
note: The robot's own arm for the camera's self-filter (pepin.arm; depth_fusion's arm_filter flag): its links posed by forward kinematics of the vendored URDF (pepin/vendor/so101), every box grown by margin_m; a depth pixel whose ray enters a grown box writes nothing on or past that point, and every voxel inside a grown box is forgotten after each integration. Read live: an edit of this file reaches the next frame. depth_fusion publishes the grown boxes on /fusion/arm (visualization_msgs/MarkerArray, base_link) whether or not the flag is on: the check is the arm's points inside them in Foxglove.
